description: ApproleSecret.secret_id is a login credential, typed as a plain string. The spec says it is `returned only at creation`, and STACKIT's docs say to store it securely (docs.stackit.cloud/products/security/secrets-manager/how-tos/configure-and-use-approles, read 2026-11-01). User.password, the equivalent for userpass, is already marked sensitive.
